title: Production loss must not alter purchase quantity
rule: production_loss_m is annotation-only; purchase quantity remains source demand

title: No mm² suffix in normalized section
rule: Canonical output expresses section numerically without mm²

title: Package length requires evidence
rule: PCS/卷/圈/扎/捆 convert to metres only with explicit pack_length_m

title: Compact prefix recognition
rule: Longest known prefix parses with or without hyphen before product token

title: Armor suffix 22/23 not silently rewritten
rule: Preserve source armor suffix unless explicit authorized mapping

title: No blind power voltage default
rule: Missing voltage on power cable yields HOLD; explicit MV preserved

title: N/PE/PEN role explicit and evidence-backed
rule: Never infer role from core count or ratio; requires approved profile and clause

title: Patch triggers revalidation
rule: Every patch reruns parsing and row validation

title: Quantity conservation starts from raw source
rule: Gate recomputes conversion from raw input and compares processed and aggregate totals

title: Unverified electrical rule cannot PASS
rule: N/PE/PEN profiles remain empty until standard and exact clause are reviewed
